editorial.blurb: Aroma Hot Pot elevates the ritual of communal dining with impeccably fresh ingredients, rich broths, and attentive service that keeps the experience flowing seamlessly.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late—they're open past typical hours—and order the medium spicy beef broth or signature spicy broth; take advantage of the included ice cream and milk/iced tea to round out your AYCE experience, and ask staff for guidance if it's your first time.
